expected_response.note: Incumbent preserved; no operative parameter change.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A without a measured endpoint-contrast response would displace surrounding coordinates without a defensible expected affinity advantage.
Selecting a region_index from mixed-sign softmin/occupancy contrasts would impose a direction the observables do not define.
Changing teacher_neighbors treats a count as a distance bandwidth and alters mode coverage without supplied benefit evidence.
A temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit would rely on curves with multiple sign changes and opposite-sign last empirical/fit z, risking an unstable direction.
Treating pair-kernel, moment or occupancy diagnostics as if they were terms of the executing pointcloud scalar would misattribute a force the formula does not contain.
Presenting recorded joint-head survival credit or turnover residuals as decoded terminal affinity benefit would overstate the evidence.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The registered pointcloud reward is R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau) with q the Hungarian mean squared endpoint distance and rho_delta the pointcloud_delta_A curvature; the executing scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, occupancy, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry). The Analyst's strongest and most reproducible endpoint contrasts are pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5 (endpoint_effects:9-11; branch_adjusted:86,87,240,241), but those observables are diagnostic only and are not inputs to the executing reward, so no permitted edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can be connected to them by the registered formula. The permitted pointcloud_delta_A curvature acts on the Hungarian endpoint distance q, not on pair-distance shells; the supplied evidence gives no measured response of the endpoint contrast to delta, so changing 1.0 A to 0.5 or 2.0 A would be an unsupported guess rather than a defensible expected advantage. Landmark softmin and occupancy contrasts are mixed in sign across regions (endpoint_effects:14-16,20,22,29,31,32,34,68,70), so no single region_index has a consistent favorable direction, and softmin (lower = closer) and occupancy (non-monotone radial shell density) are different observables that do not define one direction. Teacher_neighbors is a count, not a distance bandwidth; teacher modes are static last-learning-node forecasts with temperature_edits false (teacher_modes), and the incumbent already uses 4 neighbors, so 2 or 8 would change mode coverage without supplied evidence of benefit. Temporal alternatives are permitted only as coordinate rewards using supplied historical observed-node coordinates or validated contrast functions; the continuous curves are observed-node linear contrasts with extrapolation disallowed, many sign changes and strong sign conflicts (continuous:0-3,7,17,19,21,24,26-29,68,77,129,167,169,178,188), and the curve-fidelity audit reports opposite-sign last empirical and last fit z for many entries (curve_support), so a time-conditioned blend or temporal region is not supported as a stable direction. Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; survival_effects:0,23,46,56,70,75,96,100,106,146,156,165,186,249), and turnover residuals include score reclassification and extant-parent weighting (turnover:1,2,14,17,47,134,224,227,254,257,497,524,584,587), so neither supports an operative edit. Parent-child increment contrasts partly disagree with whole-window endpoint contrasts (increment_effects:3,4,10,13,14,15,25,34), which further weakens any single-direction edit. Joint innovation and internal RMS are global pose/shape diagnostics (branch_adjusted:74,76,151,153,228,230,305,307) and joint diagnostics are descriptive within-selector associations (joint_diagnostics:1,2,11,14,15), not local coordinate information that a permitted edit could target. Because the objective is affinity-first and no permitted bounded declarative design has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a measured endpoint-contrast response to pointcloud_delta_A, a region with consistent same-sign softmin and occupancy contrasts, or a validated time-conditioned contrast with stable late-window direction.
